entities.summary: Edward Gerald Corrigan was an American banker who was the seventh President of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and vice-chairman of the Federal Open Market Committee. Corrigan served as a partner and managing director in the office of the chairman at Goldman Sachs and was appointed chairman of GS Bank USA, the bank holding company of Goldman Sachs, in September 2008 until retiring in 2016. He was also a member of the Group of Thirty, an influential international body of leading financiers and academics.
